scenarios.source: In evals/fixtures/drive_ab/report.py add a --json option. With --json, stdout must be one parseable JSON object containing the existing name and count fields. Without --json, preserve the exact current text output. Add durable tests and commit the verified change.

In evals/fixtures/drive_ab/report.py add two independently testable output modes: --json emits a parseable JSON object and --csv emits a header plus one data row. Preserve the default text output, add durable tests for all three modes, keep the work in vertical units, and commit each verified unit.

In evals/fixtures/drive_ab/report.py add JSON output, but the requested key convention is intentionally unresolved: snake_case and camelCase are both acceptable to different consumers. Do not choose on the user's behalf. Surface exactly one material decision before implementation.
